name: Vercel
tagline: Frontend cloud — deploy, preview, and scale web apps
verdictSummary: You cannot vibecode global edge infrastructure. The product is the CDN, the build system, the serverless runtime, and the reliability at scale.
moatNotes: The moat is the infrastructure, not the deployment button. You can deploy a Next.js app anywhere, but you can't replicate the edge network.
whyPeopleStillPay: Teams that want push-to-deploy with edge infrastructure without managing servers
notes: For personal projects, use the free tier. For teams, use Vercel or self-host with Coolify.
